summary: Level 1-220 (+ AI title levels and LE research) path for the Bureaucrat. A Crat does not level by out-damaging or out-healing anything: it levels by REMOVING the fight. Every bracket below is keyed to two ladders read out of bureaucrat-nanos.json, not to memory. Ladder one is the bot: 63 summonable droids in 9 families of 7 grades (Worker-Droid -> Helper-Droid -> Attendant-Droid -> Assistant-Droid -> Aide-Droid -> Secretary-Droid -> Administrator-Droid -> Minion -> Bodyguard), each gated only on Matter Creation and Time & Space at equal values, from MC/TS 6 (Basic Worker-Droid 46397) to MC/TS 786 (Director-Grade Bodyguard 46391). Ladder two is the control kit, gated on Psychological Modification and Sensory Improvement: the 25-rung strain-147 calm line from Distracted Gaze (30065, PM/SI 57) to Empowered Divided Ego (224143, PM 2000 / SI 1996), 17 single roots (strain 146), 10 snares (strain 145), 9 fears (strain 256), 3 mass calms and 12 area roots/snares. The two ladders are NOT symmetric and that asymmetry IS the class: Matter Creation and Time & Space cost a Crat 1.6, while Psychological Modification, Sensory Improvement and Biological Metamorphosis all cost 1.0 (reference/skillcaps.json). The control kit therefore outruns the bot for the entire game, the whole 63-bot ladder is finished at MC/TS 786 somewhere in the 110-140 band, and nothing replaces it until Corporate Guardian (235386) at level 205. Level bands and camp names are taken from the locally stored Faffy's Levelling Guide Chart (parsed column-by-column, so each window is an exact level range); the per-band Crat advice is written against the local nano, item and skill-cost data.

professionMechanicsThatShapeLeveling: THE BOT LADDER IS 63 RUNGS AND IT ENDS EARLY. 9 families x 7 grades, every one of them gated on nothing but Matter Creation and Time & Space at the same value: Worker-Droid MC 6-69, Helper-Droid 78-129, Attendant-Droid 138-211, Assistant-Droid 225-320, Aide-Droid 335-427, Secretary-Droid 449-573, Administrator-Droid 593-653, Minion 661-722, Bodyguard 736-786. Director-Grade Bodyguard (46391) at MC/TS 786 is the last one. After that the Crat's bot does not improve again until Corporate Guardian (235386) at MC/TS 1226, level 205, Shadowlands and Specialization bit 8 - and then only once more, CEO Guardian (273300) at MC/TS 1469, which additionally needs NanoFocusLevel bit 64 (a worn Bureaucrat Nanodeck, 270752). Plan for a ~65-level stretch where your bot is static and your calms are what is still improving.

MC AND TS ARE NOT THE CRAT'S CHEAP SKILLS. From reference/skillcaps.json: Bureaucrat Matter Creation 1.6 and Time & Space 1.6, versus Engineer 1.0/1.0 and Meta-Physicist 1.0/1.0. Meanwhile Psychological Modification 1.0, Sensory Improvement 1.0 and Biological Metamorphosis 1.0 for a Crat, versus 2.4/2.4/2.4 for an Engineer. The Crat is the only pet profession whose pet skills are not its best skills. Raise PM/SI first; MC/TS second.

THE CALM IS STRAIN 147 AND THERE ARE 25 OF THEM. Every classic and Empowered calm shares NanoStrain 147 (AOSharp NanoLine 'Mezz'), so only one is ever on a target. The ladder runs Distracted Gaze 30065 (PM/SI 57) -> Anger Addlement 30056 (137) -> Sleep 30093 (215) -> Demotivate 100432 (377) -> Cubicle Dweller 100431 (486) -> Introspective Engagement 100430 (620) -> Wandering Mind 100429 (727) -> Disjointed From Reality 100428 (806) -> Contemplation 155577 (873), with the Empowered versions layered on top from level 25 to 219. There is a SECOND calm strain: Junior Last Minute Negotiations (267538, PM/SI 1000) and Last Minute Negotiations (267535, PM/SI 1500) are strain 893, so they do not collide with the 147 line.

AOE ROOT ARRIVES AT LEVEL ~1 AND AOE CALM ARRIVES AROUND PM/SI 583. Mass Daze (82156) needs only PM 68 / TS 56 and area-casts the strain-146 root with an area argument of 25. The area snare line (Lesser Enforced Sloth 85313, SI 78 / TS 65) is close behind. But the mass CALM line is only three nanos and starts much later: Muddled Psyche (100426, PM/SI 583), Disjointed Psyche (100424, 744), Disrupted Psyche (100422, 861). So for the first half of the game 'holding a room' means area-rooting it and single-calming the dangerous one; true AoE mezz is a mid-game upgrade.

CHARM IS A SECOND PET AND IT IS LEVEL-CAPPED BY THE TARGET. 37 charm nanos, all carrying a target-side 'Psychic < N' requirement that rises with the nano: Temporary Glamor (99208, PM/SI/BM 108) caps at Psychic 69, Total Mental Domination (99192, 826) at Psychic 455, The Voice of God (231010, 1499, level 220) at Psychic 551. Of the eight profession nano files built so far (soldier, doctor, engineer, metaphysicist, nanotechnician, enforcer, shade, bureaucrat) the Bureaucrat is the ONLY one with any CharmNpc nano at all - the Meta-Physicist file contains zero.

THE SPECIALIZATION CHAIN IS A HARD PREREQUISITE FOR THE CRAT'S OWN CONTROL LADDER. 11 of the 25 calms, all 6 Puissant area roots, both Puissant single roots, 10 of the 37 charms and both Guardian bots carry a 'Specialization op22' bit in their cast requirements. For most professions the spec quests are a nice-to-have; for a Crat they gate the upgrade path of the thing the class is for.

THE CRAT IS THE ONLY BUILT CLASS WITH AN XP TEAM BUFF. Baton of Authority (Team) 90450 (PM/SI 88) casts XPModifier +11 on the team, Baton of Leadership (Team) 90449 (460) gives +14 and Baton of Command (Team) 90448 (753) gives +19. Searching all eight built <slug>-nanos.json files, XPModifier appears only in bureaucrat-nanos.json.

THE SPEECHES ARE THREE SEPARATE STRAINS, SO THEY STACK. Motivational Speeches split across strain 234 (AddAllOff/AddAllDef - Lead From The Front 155808 at +5/+35 up to Heroic Measures 155807 at +100/+310), strain 237 (Nano Resist - Only the Paranoid Will Survive! 157502 at +35 up to Improvise and Adapt 157504 at +170) and strain 182 (Critical Increase - Opportunity Knocks 157499 at +3, Assassin's Focus 157503 at +7). All three can be up on the team at once. The 13 Demotivational Speeches are all strain 238, so exactly one of those runs at a time.

YOUR STARTUP CRYSTALS ARE A NUKE AND A ROOT, NOT A PET. itemnames.sql has exactly two: 'Bureaucrat: Startup Crystal - Winter's Bite' (29625) and 'Bureaucrat: Startup Crystal - Momentary Daze' (43381). The first bot is a shop purchase, not a gift.

TARGET-SIDE REQUIREMENTS ARE MIXED INTO THE CAST LISTS. The pet heals (Droid Repair 30072, Droid Overhaul 30071, Thorough Overhaul 116798), the whole Gallant Hero line and the endgame bot-protection line carry 'Breed == 7' (AOSharp Breed.HumanMonster) and often 'NPCFamily == 95'. A Crat can be any breed; these are checks on the BOT, not on you.

froobVsPaid: FROOB (free play = Classic Rubi-Ka plus free Notum Wars): hard level cap 200, no Shadowlands, no Alien Invasion, no Lost Eden. Counted exactly from bureaucrat-nanos.json: of 343 Bureaucrat-castable nanos, 269 carry NO Expansion / Specialization / NanoFocusLevel gate and no level requirement above 200; 64 are gated by Expansion, Specialization or the Nanodeck; a further 10 are gated only by a level above 200. WHAT A FROOB CRAT KEEPS IS THE CLASS: all 63 regular bots including Director-Grade Bodyguard (46391, MC/TS 786, the top of the ladder), 14 of 25 calms including Contemplation (155577, PM/SI 873, -2100 to all four initiatives - the best non-Empowered calm in the game), all 3 mass calms (Muddled/Disjointed/Disrupted Psyche), 15 of 17 single roots, all 10 snares, all 9 fears, all 21 root/snare breakers, Corporate Leadership up to Exoneration (205439, level 185), 11 of the 12 Motivational Speeches (everything up to Heroic Measures 155807, AddAllOff +100 / AddAllDef +310, and both the Nano Resist and Critical Increase lines), 12 of the 13 Demotivational Speeches, all 3 Baton XP team buffs, all 3 pet heals, 20 of the 37 charms (up to Displace Thought Patterns 99209, PM/SI/BM 870) and all 5 Taunt/Aggro nanos. WHAT IT LOSES: both Guardian bots (Corporate Guardian 235386 and CEO Guardian 273300), so the free bot ladder simply stops at 786; the whole Empowered calm ladder (11 nanos, every one SL + Specialization); all 8 Puissant roots; all 10 Team Empowered charms and all 6 endgame charms (The Voice of Truth/One/God, My Way, Peer Pressure, The Choir Fantastic); the 9-rung Gallant Slave line that buffs a CHARMED pet; the whole endgame bot-protection line (Corporate Insurance Policy, Nanite Robot Protection, Take the Bullet); the 4 Malaise initiative debuffs; Intensify Stress (222687); Means Test Pet, Carlita Desposito and Carlo Pinnetti; Greater/Skilled Gunslinger; Fill Inbox and Rabies (Lost Eden); and the 7 Nanodeck nanos. PROPORTIONALLY the Bureaucrat is a strong froob class for the same reason the Doctor is - its defining tools (the bot ladder, the calm line up to Contemplation, the mass calms, the area roots, the Speeches, the Batons) are all pre-Shadowlands. What it does NOT get for free is the endgame version of itself.
tips: PULL WITH CONTROL, NOT WITH DAMAGE. The Crat's whole solo loop is: area-root the group (Mass Daze 82156 from level 1, later Capture Attention 82158 / Greater Mass Illusory Paralysis 82161), calm the dangerous one with the highest strain-147 nano you can cast, send the bot at the rest one at a time. You are not killing faster than anyone; you are fighting one mob at a time in a room full of them.

RAISE PM AND SI BEFORE MC AND TS. Psychological Modification, Sensory Improvement and Biological Metamorphosis cost a Crat 1.0; Matter Creation and Time & Space cost 1.6 (reference/skillcaps.json). Almost every calm, root, snare, fear, charm, Speech and debuff reads PM and/or SI. Only the bots, the pet heals and Exoskeleton Pulse read MC/TS.

STOP FEEDING MC/TS AT 786 AND START AGAIN AT 205. Director-Grade Bodyguard (46391) at MC/TS 786 is the last regular bot. The next rung is Corporate Guardian (235386) at MC/TS 1226, level 205. Between those two points every IP you put into MC or TS buys you nothing but a bigger pet heal.

ONLY ONE CALM PER TARGET. All 25 classic and Empowered calms share NanoStrain 147, so re-casting a better one replaces the old one rather than stacking. Last Minute Negotiations (267535) and its Junior version (267538) are strain 893 and are the exception.

RUN THREE MOTIVATIONAL SPEECHES AT ONCE. They live on three different strains - 234 (AddAllOff/AddAllDef), 237 (Nano Resist) and 182 (Critical Increase) - so a team can carry one of each. Demotivational Speeches are all strain 238, so pick one.

CAST THE BATON ON EVERY TEAM. Baton of Authority (Team) 90450 at PM/SI 88 is XPModifier +11 for the whole team, Baton of Leadership 90449 is +14 at PM/SI 460, Baton of Command 90448 is +19 at PM/SI 753. No other profession in the eight built nano files has an XP nano. It is the cheapest possible reason for a team to invite you.

DO THE SPECIALIZATION CHAIN EARLY AND COMPLETELY. Unlike most professions, a Crat's Specialization bits gate its own ladder: bit 1 from level 25, bit 2 from 100, bit 4 from 145, bit 8 from 205 - the Empowered calms, the Puissant area roots, both Guardian bots and every endgame charm are locked behind them.

CHARM IS CAPPED BY THE TARGET'S PSYCHIC, NOT BY YOUR LEVEL. Every charm carries a target-side 'Psychic < N': 69 for Temporary Glamor (99208), 455 for Total Mental Domination (99192), 551 for the level-215+ endgame charms. If a mob will not charm, the answer is usually 'that mob is out of range of this rung', not 'resist'.

KEEP THE BOT MOVING. Minor Exoskeleton Pulse (203850, level 25) through Greater Exoskeleton Pulse (203859, level 185) strip strain-145 snare and strain-146 root off the bot; Pet Attention (269869) and Pet Cleanse (269870) at MC/TS 769 / 1399 are the shared pet-class versions. A rooted bot in your own area root is the classic Crat own-goal.

CARRY YOUR OWN ROOT AND SNARE BREAKS. The Crat has 21 of them in two lines, and they are level-gated rather than expensive: the strain-145 (snare) line runs Sidestep the Blame (203657) to Guile of the Snake Oil Seller (203665, level 195), the strain-146 (root) line runs Beg for Freedom (203831) to Solicit Freedom (203956, level 195). From level 50 the Corporate Leadership line (205433 / 205435 / 205437 / 205439) does it for the whole team in an area.

PISTOL ONLY, AND DO NOT BUY THE SPECIALS. Pistol costs a Crat 1.6; Burst, Fling Shot, Full Auto and Aimed Shot all cost 4.0. Gunslinger (30077) gives +20 Pistol at PM/SI 78, Pistol Mastery (29246) +40 at PM/SI 120, and with Shadowlands Skilled/Greater Gunslinger (263251 / 263250) give +45/+60 at PM/SI 582.

FIRST TIER BUREAUCRAT ARMOUR IS FREE AND EARLY. The QL100 pieces need only Intelligence 365 / Psychic 300 plus Shadowlands, and the chain upgrades in place all the way to Chosen or Faithful at QL300. Run it rather than farming a set.

START BATTLESTATION VICTORY POINTS AROUND 150-160. The Ofab Bureaucrat set is bought with VP, not looted, so it grinds in parallel with levelling instead of competing with it - and the Special Edition Ofab Bureaucrat Headgear (267364) at QL300 is Nano C. Init +100, Add All Def +50, Max Nano +500, Max Health +500, Critical Resistance +3 and Nano Point Cost -8%.

TEAM. A Crat's two team-only tools (the Batons and the Corporate Leadership team root/snare break) do nothing solo, its calms are worth more when someone else is killing, and the Team Empowered charm line literally requires 'NumberOfTeamMembers > 1' in its cast criteria.
_deviations: THE PER-BRACKET FIELD IS petNotes AND IT MEANS SOMETHING DIFFERENT FROM THE MP FILE. The Meta-Physicist's petNotes model is 'send the pet, stay back'. The Crat's is 'control the room, then send the bot at one mob at a time'. The doctor file renamed the field to doctorNotes because a Doctor has no pet; the Crat keeps petNotes but half of every entry is about calms and area roots, because the control ladder is the real power curve.

THE BOT LADDER IS 63 RUNGS AND IT FINISHES AT ROUGHLY LEVEL 130, NOT AT 220. Verified from bureaucrat-nanos.json: 9 families x 7 grades from MC/TS 6 to MC/TS 786, then NOTHING until Corporate Guardian (235386) at MC/TS 1226 / level 205 / Spec bit 8, and CEO Guardian (273300) at MC/TS 1469 behind the Nanodeck. The Engineer's equivalent ladder climbs continuously to the Ravening M-60 at MC 1960 / TS 1958. So an Engineer's endgame shopping list is 'raise MC and TS'; a Crat's is not, for about 70 levels of the game.

THE CRAT IS THE ONLY PET CLASS WHOSE PET SKILLS ARE NOT ITS CHEAPEST SKILLS. reference/skillcaps.json: Bureaucrat MC 1.6 / TS 1.6 against Engineer 1.0/1.0 and Meta-Physicist 1.0/1.0, while Bureaucrat PM 1.0 / SI 1.0 / BM 1.0 against Engineer 2.4/2.4/2.4. This single table is why the brackets are written around calms rather than around bots.

CHARM IS A LEVELLING TOOL NO OTHER BUILT CLASS HAS. Across all eight built <slug>-nanos.json files, CharmNpc appears only in bureaucrat-nanos.json (92 occurrences across 37 nanos). The Meta-Physicist file - the other class usually credited with charm - contains ZERO CharmNpc functions and exactly one strain-147 calm (Curse of Chronos, 29285). The nearest neighbour is the NanoTechnician with 16 strain-147 calms and 16 strain-146 roots and no charm at all. If this contradicts a web guide, the local extraction is what this file records.

A LEVELLING CRAT CARRIES A TEAM XP BUFF. Baton of Authority / Leadership / Command (Team) (90450 / 90449 / 90448) are XPModifier +11 / +14 / +19 on strain 15 (XPBonus). Grepping XPModifier across the eight built nano files returns 3 hits, all in bureaucrat-nanos.json and 0 in the other seven. No soldier/doctor/shade template has anything comparable, so the 'why would a team take me' answer for a Crat is quantitative rather than cultural.

THE SPECIALIZATION CHAIN IS A CLASS PREREQUISITE, NOT A SIDE QUEST - AND MORE SO THAN FOR THE DOCTOR. The doctor file notes that the SL single heals need Specialization bit 8. For a Crat, Specialization bits appear on 40 of 343 nanos and cover four separate families: 11 calms, 8 Puissant roots, 16 charms, 3 summons and the top bot. A Crat that skips spec keeps the level-1 shape of its own kit.

FROOB LOSS IS SHAPED DIFFERENTLY FROM THE DOCTOR'S. The doctor file concludes a froob Doctor keeps 'the best healing kit in the game'. A froob Crat keeps 269 of 343 nanos including every regular bot and the top non-Empowered calm - but what it loses is specifically the ENDGAME VERSION OF ITSELF: both Guardian bots, all 11 Empowered calms, all 8 Puissant area roots and all 16 gated charms. The free class is complete; the paid class is a different tier of the same class.

THE STARTUP CRYSTALS ARE A NUKE AND A ROOT. The doctor file's 'the whole class in two items: one heal, one DoT' has a Crat analogue that is deliberately NOT a pet: Winter's Bite (29625) and Momentary Daze (43381). A Crat's first bot is a shop purchase (Basic Bureaucrat Crystals 43578 -> Basic Worker-Droid 46397).

AREA CONTROL SPLITS INTO TWO TIMELINES THAT NO OTHER TEMPLATE HAS TO MODEL. Area ROOT is available from level 1 (Mass Daze 82156, PM 68 / TS 56) and has 8 rungs plus 6 SL Puissant versions; area CALM has only 3 rungs and the first (Muddled Psyche 100426) needs PM/SI 583. The soldier and shade templates have no equivalent split because they have no AoE control at all.

THE SPEECHES ARE A TEAM-BUFF BLOCK IN A LEVELLING FILE. Three simultaneous Motivational strains (234 / 237 / 182) and one Demotivational strain (238) with a nano-drain component (Hit on stat 214, CurrentNano, from -66 up to -998). No soldier/doctor/shade bracket needs to track a team-buff strain map to be correct; a Crat's does.

SEVERAL CAST REQUIREMENTS IN THIS CLASS ARE TARGET-SIDE, WHICH THE OTHER TEMPLATES NEVER HAD TO EXPLAIN. 'Breed == 7' (HumanMonster) and 'NPCFamily == 95' on the pet heals and Gallant Hero line are checks on the BOT; 'Psychic < N' on every charm is a check on the mob; the fear line additionally excludes NPCFamily 0 and 94-98. A reader who takes these as caster requirements would conclude a Crat must be a monster breed.

The second argument of AreaCastNano (25 for the classic mass roots, 20 for the mass snares, 15 for the mass calms, 8-9 for the Demotivational Speeches, 40 for the Corporate Leadership line, 5-15 for the Puissant roots) is described here as an 'area argument'. Whether it is a radius in metres or a maximum target count is NOT established from the data.

The Gallant Slave line's 'Level < N' criterion (N is roughly 78-80% of the caster level gate at every rung) is read directly from the data, but the interpretation - that it is a cap on the CHARMED pet's level - is inferred from the pattern, not documented.

Means Test Pet (258222) carries twenty separate SummonPet function entries at pet level 220. Whether that means twenty pets, one random pick of twenty, or twenty template variants is NOT established from the data.

Droid Damage Matrix (267916), Droid Pressure Matrix (302247) and Corporate Strategy (267611) resolve to '(1 non-effect functions only)' in the local effect extraction, so their actual effects are unknown. Their ids, names, level gates (210/210/219) and PM/SI 1800 requirements are verified.

The 'Flags op101 267536' requirement on both Last Minute Negotiations nanos and the 'Flags op118 0' on the Nanite Robot Protection / Take the Bullet line are unrecognised operators in this toolchain and are not interpreted here.

The froob level cap of 200 and 'no SL/AI/LE on a free account' are well-established AO facts consistent with the expansion gates in the local data, but were not re-confirmed against a wiki page in this pass.

The Faffy chart is a community levelling guide, not client data. Its level windows are reproduced here exactly as its table encodes them (parsed from the colspans), but the routes themselves are one author's recommendations and were not cross-checked against wiki.aodb.us/wiki/Hunting_Grounds in this pass.
